name: Data Browser Boiler Room (Web)
implementation_notes: BoilerRoomRecordService/Controller/routes/factories/models/migrations are shared infrastructure for all 3 web Boiler Room screens (098/108/118), mirroring EngineRoomRecordService's precedent -- reported under this screen since it is first in the implementation sequence. Models/migrations were already generated in an earlier (Phase 1/entity-catalog) pass per the task brief; this pass verified them against the service/controller code (using the migration as ground truth for the exact column list) and found them consistent, requiring no changes

Boiler Room follows the same hourly-grid (dynamic add-row/remove-row, 1..24 rows, unique + strictly ascending canonical time_slot) pattern as Engine Room -- create()/update()/listRecords()/export()/getDetail(), plus canonicalTimeSlots() helper returning 24 'HH:00' strings starting 07:00

filled_slot_count computed via withCount() with an inner OR-whereNotNull constraint across all 15 non-time_slot columns -- mirrors EngineRoomRecordService's filled_slot_count pattern; this station has NO identifying/context columns to exclude (no shift/inspector_id equivalent), so all 15 columns participate

IMPORTANT -- enum empty-string-vs-null: 2 of the 15 detail columns (blowdown_executed, sootblowing_executed) are backed by a SQLite CHECK constraint (Laravel enum('y','n')) that rejects an empty string. BoilerRoomRecordService::normalizeDetails() coerces '' to null for these columns specifically before validation/persistence -- the same mitigation Engine Room/Kernel Dispatch/Effluent Plant/Storage Tank needed for their own enum columns. Proactively implemented per explicit task instruction, verified by a dedicated unit test

3 detail columns (fuel_feed_rate, id_fan_load, sa_fan_load) are kept as free-text string columns end-to-end (request body, migration, service, FE) rather than numeric, per explicit task instruction: the paper-form units are mixed/ambiguous (Hz/%/tons for Fuel Feed Rate, A/% for ID/SA Fan Load)

UNLIKE Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping/Kernel Plant: Boiler Room has NO operational-target reference table -- no seeder, no model, no Target Operasional section anywhere in this station's 6 screens, per this task's explicit scope

The Boiler Room tile in production-process-activity.blade.php (screen-035) was updated from a javascript:void(0) placeholder to route('data.boiler-room') -- 2 of the 2026-08-31 batch (Clarification, Process Quality Control) now remain unrouted, decremented from 3
tests/Feature/ProductionProcessActivityTest.php updated: Boiler Room moved from the 'still-unrouted' test into the routed-tiles test (renamed to 'renders the 2 still-unrouted...')
StationFactory::boilerRoom() state added additively (mirrors engineRoom()/storageTank()/effluentPlant() exactly) for this screen's and screen-118's test suites

Ran the full backend test suite (`php artisan test`) after implementation: 1974 passed, 1 pre-existing unrelated flaky failure (Tests\Unit\Services\CagesTrackRecordServiceTest -- a UNIQUE constraint collision from Faker-generated random data, reproduced in isolation as passing, confirmed unrelated to this station's changes). Boiler-Room-specific tests (`--filter=BoilerRoom`): 91 passed (0 failed) -- 34 unit (BoilerRoomRecordServiceTest), 7 integration (Feature/Api/DataBrowserBoilerRoomTest), 5 component (Feature/Livewire/DataBrowserBoilerRoomTest), reported under this screen; remaining 45 Boiler Room tests reported under screen-108/screen-118 below
